reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules (the matching tolerance) and the existing getScheduledAmount/getWorstCaseAmount, and replaces schedule-template's own isbetween dispatch with the shared helper.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once in getApproxWorstCaseAmount/getPlannedAmount; callers only pass their operator, and one local copy of the dispatch is removed.

placement.why: The amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts beside the range rule, taking the tolerance from shared/rules where matching defines it.

scope.why: The many touched call sites are each just forwarding the operator so the rule reaches every planning path; nothing unrelated is changed, though a few call sites are left on the old signature.

maintainability.why: One small dispatch function owns the rule, but the operator is an untyped string slotted before the boolean inverse flag, and the two useScheduleEdit calls are left without it.

one_place.where: getPlannedAmount/getApproxWorstCaseAmount inside getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; server, forecast, template, API and client callers pass their amount operator to it.
